verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Morph exposes OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, so users can point the third-party OpenAI SDK at Morph's base URL. It also publishes an OpenAPI document. Neither is a first-party Morph SDK: the evidence never names or documents an official Morph client library or package, so drop-in compatibility with another vendor's SDK is an adjacent building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
